run_benchmark_suite: run all benchmark functions in bm_*.py files by executing bm_main.py with no arguments
run_benchmark_module: run benchmarks for a specific module by passing bm_module_name as a command line argument
run_benchmark_function: run a specific bm_ prefixed benchmark function discovered via dynamic import in the module
review_main_function: review the main function that discovers and executes all bm_ prefixed benchmark functions
summarize_benchmark_discovery: summarize how bm_main.py uses glob and importlib to auto-discover and run benchmark modules
